// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// expressions / comptime / expressions and blocks
const size = comptime sizeOf<User>();
//           ^^^^^^^^ keyword.other.comptime.ds

comptime {
// <- keyword.other.comptime.ds
    assert(layoutOf<User>().size > 0);
}

// expressions / comptime / static if annotations
@if(import.meta.runtime == "js")
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
function runtimeName(): string {
    "js"
}

function make<comptime N: uint>(value: [uint8; N]): Buffer<N> {
//            ^^^^^^^^ keyword.other.comptime.ds
    Buffer.from(value)
}
